title: Burmese pythons removed from the Florida Everglades, May-July

source.name: Python Elimination Program / PATRIC removal totals
source.publisher: Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission (FWC) / South Florida Water Management District

notes: State-contracted hunters removed 343 pythons in the May-July window of 2024 and 1,022 in the same window of 2025, part of a program that has removed nearly 28,000 wild Burmese pythons since 2000.
